dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, the atmosphere at the camp has become way more relaxed. If I gave you the impression that I was the overly-serious sort before, I'm very sorry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: The important business has already been settled. Now, the long-term work that remains is... setting up a permanent watch underground to check for anymore odd changes.
